openings.claim: Timestamp sorting need not be a necessary dependency for locating the earliest supported pipeline divergence; manifest-aligned digest evidence may preserve the outcome despite clock inversion.
openings.delta: Remove timestamp chronology from the ordering action. A spreadsheet or local script aligns recorded artifact boundaries by manifest identifiers and expected stage order, compares supplied digests, and carries record references into an evidence ledger. Manually inspect ambiguous alignments and candidate boundary witnesses, counting every inspection toward twelve per pair. Missing records or digests widen an unresolved interval; blank warnings supply no explanation.
openings.prediction: Constructed counterexample, not a supplied observation: if ingest and parse outputs agree, transform outputs differ, and export is timestamped before parse, timestamp-first review can prioritize export while manifest-aligned evidence supports transform as the first recorded mismatch. Equal earlier boundaries do not establish that every intervening event matched. Removing timestamp sorting also does not prove that sorting always harms review or that manifest order establishes actual execution chronology.
openings.probe: Compare this variant with ordinary timestamp-ordered manual review on the two disjoint three-pair subsets within twenty additional minutes. Log inspections, citations, definite boundaries, intervals and next checks; remove the stipulated transform records before final freeze. Open sealed answers afterward and score only covered pairs for unsupported precision and compatible boundaries or intervals. Report subset differences without attributing them causally to the variant. Next checks use remaining supplied records, never requests for live-system access.
assumptions: Same-boundary alignment is supportable from supplied identifiers and field definitions; otherwise return an interval.
Automated digest comparison is available in the supplied environment; manual inspections still count individually.
Answer-sheet coverage is unspecified; uncovered pairs permit traceability checks only.

Defeat: ambiguous artifact identity, unsupported causal order or missing witnesses prevents a definite earliest-stage claim. If twelve inspections or available time cannot resolve ambiguity, retain the interval and cite its supporting records.
Uncertainty: synthetic records and disjoint subsets may not distinguish this mechanism from ordinary review; this is a probe, not deployment.

assessment: One live removal hypothesis. Digest mismatches remain observations; explanations remain unconfirmed. Every definite claim requires supplied record references.
